articles.body: Plaqueboymax’s Halloween 2026 livestream has led to a public clash with Adin Ross and former FaZe Clan figure Ricky “Banks” Bengtson. Max and his crew dressed as stereotypical white men and copied their voices and mannerisms. Adin joked that he and his friends could do blackface in a stream, prompting Max to question his respect for Black culture. Banks then argued that Max’s costume showed a lack of respect for white people. He later turned his criticism toward Max’s career, saying the streamer had fallen short of the huge future he once expected for Max.Adin Ross and Plaqueboymax disagree over Black culture after Halloween livestreamThe controversy started after Plaqueboymax and his friends appeared in their Halloween costumes during a Twitch livestream on October 31, 2026. Their outfits and impressions were based on stereotypical white men. The clips later caught Adin Ross' attention during his own Kick stream.Adin found the costumes funny and suggested that he could try something similar with his friends Cheesur and Konvy. However, his idea involved wearing blackface.He said:"This is hilarious... what if me, Cheesur, Konvy, bro, we all do blackface? I ain't gon' lie, that might be a banger stream, chat... If they can do it, I can do it!"His comment did not sit well with Plaqueboymax. The Twitch streamer later addressed Adin directly and questioned why he was comfortable making such a suggestion when Black culture had played a major role in his success.Plaqueboymax said:"Adin, you confuse me, bruh. You deeply confuse me. A lot of your success is rooted in Black culture. My question is, why don't you respect Black culture?"Max also made it clear that he still considered Adin one of his favourite streamers. His issue was with the suggestion of using blackface for entertainment.The discussion then took another turn when Banks shared his thoughts. He argued that if wearing blackface showed disrespect towards Black culture, then Max's decision to dress up as a white man should also be seen as disrespectful towards white people.Banks said:"This is a self-report. You're saying you don't respect White culture, or white people. Because if him doing blackface equals disrespecting Black culture, then you doing whiteface equals disrespecting White culture."FaZe Banks says Plaqueboymax was supposed to become the next Kai CenatBanks' comments did not stop at the Halloween costume. He also brought up Max's career and questioned the kind of content he had been making recently.The two streamers have a history of disagreements. Both were connected to FaZe Clan before their departures in 2025. Max left the organization in August, while the group faced a major split among its content creators during Christmas. Several creators announced their exits on December 25 and 26, 2025. The departures marked a major change for FaZe's content division, while its esports operation continued separately, as reported by Dexerto.Tension between Banks and Max had already been building before the Halloween incident. During the FaZe fallout, Banks had criticised Max and reportedly described him as having an ego. Their latest disagreement has brought those earlier issues back into the discussion.Reacting to Max's Halloween stream, Banks questioned whether the streamer was now relying on controversial moments to get attention. He also brought up criticism of Max's music and the negative reactions he had seen to his livestreams.Banks said:"This is the only way you can get views now... All I see clips of you is bull**** like this. It's you crying on stream, you saying outlandish, delusional, ****, and people clowning you and trashing your music, or **** like this, doing whiteface. What the **** are you doing?"He then reminded viewers of the expectations he once had for Max. Banks believed the streamer had the potential to become one of the biggest names in the streaming world.He added:"You were supposed to be the next Kai Cenat. You were supposed to be one of the biggest, greatest streamers of all time."Banks also brought up Max's ambition to perform at the Super Bowl halftime show. He appeared doubtful that the streamer would ever reach that stage and made a bold promise about what he would do if Max achieved that goal.Banks said:"Talking about you're gonna do the halftime show... Max, on everything I love, if you ever perform the halftime show, in our lifetime... I will get '5STAR PLAQUEBOYMAX' tattooed across the middle of my face in big, blocky, bold bubble letters."Banks' remarks added another personal issue to the disagreement. Rather than focusing only on whether the Halloween costumes were acceptable, he questioned what had happened to the potential he once saw in Max.The exchange has also brought attention back to the difficult relationship between the two former FaZe associates. articles.title: Ram, the divine light that illuminates the universe
articles.summary: UP CM Yogi Adityanath highlights Ayodhya’s 10th Deepotsav with lakhs of diyas, global cultural events, tech shows, tourism jobs and local artisans.
articles.body: Goswami Tulsidas Ji has described Lord Shri Ram as the supreme light that illuminates the entire universe, both living and non-living. Deepotsav is the grand festival through which we experience this divine radiance and cultural consciousness. The celebration of Deepotsav in Ayodhya revives the sacred tradition of the time when the entire city of Awadh was illuminated with countless diyas upon the return of Lord Shri Ram after 14 years of exile. It proclaims the eternal civilisational belief that the light of truth, righteousness and dignity shall always remain supreme.Shri Ayodhya Dham, the foremost among the Saptapuris, is today adorned to welcome the 10th edition of Deepotsav. Organised at the birthplace of Lord Shri Ram, this festival has emerged as a global celebration of India’s Sanatan consciousness and cultural pride. The attention of the entire Sanatan world is focused on Ayodhya, as devotees of Lord Ram from across India and abroad eagerly await the opportunity to witness this extraordinary celebration.When, in 2017, the people of Uttar Pradesh blessed us with the responsibility of serving them, a question and a resolve occupied our minds: What must that moment have been like when Shri Ram returned to his birthplace along with Mata Janaki and younger brother Lakshman after 14 years of exile and the destruction of adharma? With what joy must the men and women of Awadh have set aside everything else to illuminate every street, every doorstep and every threshold with diyas! Although we have not witnessed Ayodhya of the Treta Yuga, with the blessings of the Lord, we are today recreating that divine splendour with the confidence of modern India.Our eternal connection with Deepotsav is rooted not merely in traditions but also in the highest values of life. For 14 years, the revered Bharat Ji renounced the comforts of kingship and administered the kingdom of Ayodhya by placing Lord Shri Ram’s sacred padukas on the throne. This revered episode from the Ramayan teaches us that the true meaning of governance and power lies not in authority but in the responsibility to work for public welfare. Through Deepotsav, Ayodhya is once again placing this noble spirit of sacrifice, dignity, service and dedication before the world.Alongside this divine splendour, however, we must also remember that dark chapter of history when our faith was subjected to decades of neglect and indignity. Ayodhya, described in the scriptures as ‘Avani Ki Amaravati’ was pushed into an era of deliberate neglect after Independence by the politics of appeasement, narrow vote-bank interests and pseudo-secularism. It was a painful period when even the existence of Lord Shri Ram was questioned and people hesitated to speak about their own Sanatan culture. When the sacred pilgrimage centres that we regard as the soul of our nation were left neglected, the very spirit of the country’s overall progress was undermined.The previous Samajwadi Party and Congress governments will always be asked why they never took the initiative to organise the celebration of Deepawali in Ayodhya, even though its very foundation is the return of Lord Shri Ram to Ayodhya. The issue concerning the birthplace was before the court, but there was no restriction on celebrating matters of faith. It was evident that their politics was driven by the disregard for the religious sentiments of the majority community. When we began this journey in 2017 with 1.71 lakh diyas, they ridiculed the initiative. Today, the same Deepotsav has become a global symbol of public participation and world records.The 10th edition of Deepotsav represents an unprecedented confluence of the contemporary outlook of the new generation and eternal faith. Today’s youth live in the digital age, and it was therefore our responsibility to connect tradition with modern technology. The magnificent rows of diyas along the banks of Saryu, the radiance of lakhs of diyas at Ram Ki Paidi, live cultural performances on floating stages over the river, 3D episodes from the Ramayan brought alive on screens through augmented reality, and the depiction of the Ramayan in the night sky through laser shows and drones will lend an extraordinary grandeur to the festival. The participation of cultural troupes from 12 countries has reaffirmed that the character and ideals of Lord Shri Ram are not confined to any geographical boundary but serve as a guiding light of truth, peace and dignity for all humanity.The most sacred aspect of this grand celebration is the confluence of faith and the economy. We firmly believe that wherever there is light, there is security; wherever there is security, there are opportunities for investment; wherever there is investment, there is development; and wherever there is development, there are opportunities for employment, happiness and prosperity. Deepotsav is not merely an event to illuminate Ayodhya with diyas. It is an opportunity to make those traditions an integral part of our lives once again, which had been neglected over time. For years, our folk art, folk culture and traditional crafts did not receive the recognition and respect they deserved. Concrete efforts in this direction gained momentum after the formation of the government at the Centre under the leadership of PM Narendra Modi in 2014 and the formation of the double-engine government in Uttar Pradesh in 2017.Local artisans, craftsmen, traditional workers and potters have made a significant contribution to the grandeur of Deepotsav. Their art and hard work keep our traditions alive. The ‘One District, One Product’ scheme has given a new identity to the local products and traditional crafts of the state. The ‘One District, One Cuisine’ scheme, launched this year, will further promote the culinary traditions of our districts. The contribution of these skilled hands has helped UP’s annual exports cross Rs 2 lakh crore. Their contribution to the state’s economy reflects the immense potential of our traditional art and craftsmanship.Deepotsav has created extensive employment and new avenues of income for local clay artisans, potter communities, flower vendors, boatmen, small street vendors, handicraft workers, and those engaged in the hotel and homestay businesses. Religious tourism has opened up immense livelihood opportunities for the local youth of Ayodhya. When faith becomes a pillar of the economy, diya of prosperity naturally lights up in the home of the person standing at the last rung of society.Extending this very spirit of Antyodaya, the state government has provided free LPG cylinders to 1.89 crore Ujjwala beneficiary families across UP on this auspicious occasion. When the burden of smoke is removed from a mother’s kitchen and her face radiates the glow of self-respect, the true purpose of welfare-oriented governance is fulfilled. The Maharishi Valmiki International Airport, the state-of-the-art Ayodhya Dham railway station, the wide and well-developed Dharam Path, Bhakti Path and Ram Path, along with the rejuvenated ghats, stand as testimony to the fact that when policies are guided by commitment and intentions are sincere, development and heritage move forward together.This Deepawali, I urge everyone to celebrate a ‘Local Wali Diwali’. Decorate your homes with diyas made by local potters and products crafted by local artisans. While choosing gifts for your loved ones, give preference to the artworks and products made by local craftsmen. Even a small initiative on our part can bring prosperity to an artisan’s household. The resolve of Vocal for Local is a commitment to enriching our own soil, our art and our people. Let us embrace local products this Deepawali and help take the skills and craftsmanship of our state to greater heights.I invite all of you to visit Ayodhya with your families and friends and witness the extraordinary splendour of Deepotsav. May every household be filled with happiness, every heart be imbued with harmony, and may the path of progress of our nation continue to advance unhindered. With this prayer, I extend my heartfelt best wishes to all devotees of Lord Ram on the occasion of Ayodhya Deepotsav and the festival of lights, Deepawali.Siyavar Ramchandra Ki Jai!(Writer is UP CM)You Can Also Check: Gold Rate in Lucknow | Silver Rate in Lucknow | Bank Holidays in Lucknow | Public Holidays in Lucknow | Lucknow AQI | Weather in Lucknow | Petrol Price in Lucknow | Diesel Price in Lucknow | CNG Price in Lucknow | LPG Price in LucknowStay updated with the latest Lucknow news. articles.title: Rihanna's foundation is transforming a Jamaican primary school into a hurricane shelter designed to protect the surrounding community during extreme weather
articles.summary: Rihanna's Clara Lionel Foundation is leading a US$1.44 million project to upgrade Hopewell Primary School in Watchwell, St Elizabeth, Jamaica, into a
articles.body: Rihanna's Clara Lionel Foundation is leading a US$1.44 million project to upgrade Hopewell Primary School in Watchwell, St Elizabeth, Jamaica, into a climate-resilient facility designed to withstand powerful hurricanes and provide emergency shelter for surrounding communities. The school serves approximately 100 students and already functions as a designated hurricane shelter for residents in the rural area. The planned improvements include structural reinforcement, hurricane shutters, solar power with battery backup, emergency water infrastructure and accessibility upgrades. The project aims to help the school continue operating as an educational institution while providing a safer refuge when extreme weather threatens the region. According to a July 2026 report, construction was under way, with completion expected in December 2026.A school designed to protect the wider communityHopewell Primary School is located in Watchwell, in St Elizabeth, a parish in southwestern Jamaica known for its agricultural production. Beyond educating children, the school serves as an important emergency shelter for people living in surrounding rural communities.The Clara Lionel Foundation is leading the upgrade through its Rebuild & Reimagine Fund, working with Jamaican government agencies and local organisations. The project is intended to strengthen the building so it can support students during normal operations and provide shelter during disasters.The foundation's 2025 annual report identifies Hopewell as part of its broader effort to strengthen public infrastructure against extreme weather. The initiative reflects an approach in which schools serve both educational needs and wider community resilience.Reinforcing the building against powerful hurricanesThe US$1.44 million project includes structural reinforcement of the school's columns, beams and foundations. According to the Jamaica Observer, the building is being upgraded to withstand hurricane-force winds of up to 181.5 miles per hour, equivalent to approximately 292 kilometres per hour.The planned work also includes replacing the roof, walls, windows and doors, alongside installing hurricane shutters. These improvements are intended to reduce the risk of structural damage during severe storms and help the facility remain usable when residents need emergency shelter.The project also incorporates measures intended to improve the building's resilience to seismic activity. The reported wind speed represents a design specification, rather than evidence of the building having already survived a storm of that intensity.Solar power to support emergency operationsHurricanes can disrupt electricity supplies for extended periods, making it difficult for shelters to maintain essential services. To address this risk, the school is being equipped with solar panels, battery storage and a standby generator designed to provide up to 72 hours of emergency power.The system is intended to help maintain electricity when the main grid fails. Reliable power can support lighting and other essential operations while residents shelter inside the building.The combination of renewable energy, battery backup and a generator is designed to make the facility more self-sufficient during emergencies, when outside assistance and normal utility services may be difficult to access.A system designed to produce drinking water from airAnother distinctive feature of the project is an atmospheric water generation system supplied by EcoSky Water. The technology is designed to extract moisture from the air and produce potable water.Safe drinking water can become difficult to obtain after hurricanes damage water infrastructure or contaminate conventional supplies. The planned system, combined with centralised water storage, is intended to strengthen the school's ability to provide water during emergencies.The upgrade also includes improved plumbing and wash facilities to support the needs of students and residents using the building as a shelter.Accessibility and improvements for studentsThe renovation extends beyond structural reinforcement and emergency utilities. Plans include improved disability access, enhanced evacuation infrastructure and wider improvements across the school campus.These features are important for a facility expected to accommodate people with different needs during a disaster. Accessible facilities and safer evacuation routes can make shelters more usable for children, older people and people with disabilities.The project also includes a new playground for students, ensuring that the investment improves the school's everyday learning environment as well as its emergency role.How hurricanes highlighted the need for resilient infrastructureJamaica's exposure to powerful storms has made disaster preparedness a continuing priority. Hurricanes Beryl in 2024 and Melissa in 2025 highlighted the vulnerability of communities and public infrastructure to extreme weather.When schools and other public buildings are damaged, the effects extend beyond the immediate destruction. Children can lose access to education, while residents may have fewer safe places to shelter during emergencies.The Hopewell project aims to address these challenges by strengthening an existing community institution. Instead of serving only as a place of learning, the upgraded school is intended to provide shelter and access to essential services when severe weather disrupts daily life.The approach also reflects a wider regional effort to improve the resilience of schools, healthcare facilities and other public buildings across the Caribbean.Rihanna's foundation and its climate-resilience workRihanna established the Clara Lionel Foundation in 2012. The organisation supports initiatives related to climate resilience, education, health equity and community development.Its Rebuild & Reimagine Fund supports recovery and reconstruction efforts designed to help communities prepare for future disasters. The Hopewell project brings these priorities together by strengthening an educational facility that also serves as an emergency shelter.The initiative involves collaboration with Jamaican public institutions and local partners, including the Office of Disaster Preparedness and Emergency Management, the Ministry of Education, Skills, Youth and Information, the National Education Trust and the St Elizabeth Municipal Corporation. The Breds Treasure Beach Foundation and Liberty Caribbean Foundation are also providing support.The foundation's 2025 annual report describes Hopewell as part of its wider investment in resilient education infrastructure, with schools designed to serve as both learning centres and community shelters.When is the project expected to be completed?A report published by the Jamaica Observer on July 7, 2026, said construction was under way, with completion expected in December 2026.The work has been planned to minimise disruption to teaching. Temporary classrooms are to be established on the school's netball court, while major construction activities are scheduled around weekends, after-school hours and school holidays where possible.Hopewell Primary School principal Marie Caroll Bromfield welcomed the investment, saying it would improve the learning environment while providing a climate-resilient refuge for the wider community.Krystle Francis, the Clara Lionel Foundation's director of programmes for the Caribbean, described Hopewell as a critical hurricane shelter serving a wide rural area. She said the project was intended to create infrastructure that could function as both an educational institution and an emergency shelter.Once completed, the upgraded facility is expected to strengthen the community's ability to respond to extreme weather while continuing to serve students throughout the school year.You use AI every day. articles.summary: Ayodhya set for 10th Deepotsav with 30 lakh diyas across 56 Saryu ghats; VP CP Radhakrishnan to inaugurate as CM Yogi, Guv attend.
articles.body: Lucknow: With streets bathed in colourful lights, ghats decked up for a sea of flickering diyas and the temple town reverberating with festive fervour, Ayodhya is set to celebrate the 10th edition of Deepotsav on Saturday.As preparations gather pace to illuminate 56 ghats along the Saryu and other prominent locations with 30 lakh diyas, Vice-President CP Radhakrishnan will inaugurate the celebrations in the presence of Governor Anandiben Patel, chief minister Yogi Adityanath and religious leaders.From the illuminated Ram Ki Paidi and brightly decorated Lata Mangeshkar Chowk to the bustling streets lined with festive installations, Ayodhya is wearing a celebratory look.The festivities, featuring cultural performances, laser and drone shows, musical fireworks and Ramlila presentations, have already drawn international tourists and brought a surge in business for small traders.Preparations are underway across Ram Ki Paidi, Saryu ghats, Ram Katha Park and major intersections, where decorative lighting, cultural performances and religious programmes will mark annual celebrations.Ram temple will also be illuminated with colourful lights.Vice-President Radhakrishnan will offer prayers at the Ram temple before attending Deepotsav celebrations.He will participate in religious ceremonies at Ram Katha Park, including prayers and ‘aarti’ of Ram-Janaki, and felicitate seers. He will also attend Saryu Aarti at Naya Ghat and participate as chief guest in the main Deepotsav programme at Ram Ki Paidi. He will witness musical fireworks before returning to Delhi.Chief minister Yogi Adityanath will join the Vice-President, governor Anandiben Patel and religious leaders for the celebrations. Deputy chief ministers Keshav Prasad Maurya and Brajesh Pathak, along with several ministers and public representatives, are also expected to attend the event.A procession depicting the symbolic return of Lord Ram, Sita and Lakshman to Ayodhya will feature participation from 13 states, with tableaux showcasing episodes from the Ramayana. Major roads, including Dharm Path, are being decorated with thematic lighting and LED panels.Ram Ki Paidi will host 3D projection mapping, laser shows and live cultural performances, while a drone show depicting scenes from the Ramayana and musical fireworks at Naya Ghat will be among the major attractions.Ramlila troupes from India and abroad will stage performances, while nearly 2,000 artists will participate in cultural programmes across the temple town.Meanwhile, the festivities have attracted visitors from abroad, including Shane, an Australian tourist who travelled to Ayodhya after learning about Deepotsav while witnessing Diwali preparations among the Indian community in Malaysia.Shane, who is on a spiritual journey across India, said he was impressed by the illuminated streets, cultural performances and decorations at Ram Ki Paidi and Lata Mangeshkar Chowk.“Ayodhya is extraordinary. I feel completely safe here, and the atmosphere is filled with positive energy,” he said. Shane will remain in Ayodhya till Monday before proceeding to Varanasi.The growing tourist footfall has also benefited small traders operating along the Saryu ghats. Vendors selling ‘Ramyantra’, a traditional devotional musical instrument, are reporting higher earnings during the festive period.Sachindranath, a vendor from Gorakhpur, sells a pair of ‘Ramyantras’ for Rs 50. His daily earnings, normally between Rs 800 and Rs 1,000, have increased to Rs 1,800 to Rs 2,500 during Deepotsav.Similarly, Rajendra Mahtur from Bihar, who has been selling ‘Ramyantras’ for three years, said his daily income increased from around Rs 800 to Rs 2,000 during the celebrations. He attributed the increase in sales to the growing number of visitors following the construction of the Ram temple.The district administration has deployed magistrates at major venues and assigned separate responsibilities for crowd management, traffic, cultural programmes and VIP movement.Chief development officer Krishna Kumar Singh will supervise arrangements at Ram Katha Park, while additional district magistrate Amit Kumar Bhatt will oversee activities at Ram Ki Paidi.ADM City and Mela Adhikari, Dinesh, will supervise arrangements for lighting of diyas, while ADM Indrakant Dwivedi will oversee traffic management.District magistrate Shashank Tripathi said the security and convenience of devotees and guests remained the administration’s priorities.‘Yogi govt’s efforts have given Deepotsav global recognition’On the eve of Deepotsav, seers hailed the Yogi Adityanath govt for its efforts in organising the event in Ayodhya and said that Deepotsav has earned global recognition.Jagatguru Swami Satishacharya, who visited the town to review preparations, said Deepotsav should inspire people to follow Lord Ram’s ideals beyond the ceremonial lighting of lamps.“Just as Ayodhya was illuminated with lamps upon the arrival of Shri Ram during Treta Yuga, today, through the efforts of Yogi ji, same city of Lord Ram is once again conveying the message of light to the entire world,” he said.Saint Shashikant Das said, “The concept of Ram Rajya is based on love, harmony, equality and social cohesion. The ideals of Prabhu Shri Ram continue to have the power to show society the right direction even today.”Sant Akash Das said, “Before 2017, there was a sense of uncertainty among the youth regarding religion, Sanatan and culture. CM Yogi served as a guiding force and made meaningful efforts to reconnect youth with their traditions and cultural heritage. articles.title: After reported cases of broken bones, brain damage and other injuries; US Consumer Product Safety Commission issues red alert; tells Lowe’s, Costco and Amazon to recall 3.6 million …
articles.summary: The US Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC) has issued an alert notifying consumers across America that 3.6 million ladders are being recalled
articles.body: The US Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC) has issued an alert notifying consumers across America that 3.6 million ladders are being recalled because they could unexpectedly retract due to faulty locks. According to reports, warning comes after a number of people sustained broken bones, brain damage and other injuries.US CPSC has published a recall notice warning consumers that approximately 3,662,000 (3.6 million) ladders made by Little Giant Ladder Systems were being recalled after the company received several reports of the ladders unexpectedly retracting, causing serious injuries to users. As per CPSC's warning to buyers: "Ladders can suddenly retract if the Rapid Locks are not fully engaged, posing a fall hazard to consumers."The faulty ladders have been sold on Lowes, Amazon, Costco, LittleGiantLadders and other websites. As per the consumer body, the 3.6 million-plus ladders included in this recall were sold nationally between December 2015 and October 2026. The ladders sold are priced anywhere from around $100 to around $1,000.The CPSC's notice says that the Rapid Locks are black or orange components on the ladders’ legs, designed to be inserted to adjust the ladders’ height. When the Rapid Locks don’t work as intended, the ladders can suddenly retract, causing the user to fall and sustain serious injuries. Little Giant has also published its own recall notice, in which the ladder manufacturer warns of the same hazard.What US CPSC 'red notice' says"Consumers should stop using the recalled ladders immediately until they review the information at or via the QR code on the ladder and contact Little Giant for a repair kit containing warning labels and instructions. The additional instructions and labels, which should be affixed to the ladder, advise consumers to verify that their Rapid Locks are properly engaged before every use and to maintain their locks with lubrication. Consumers who follow the provided instructions and have a Rapid Lock that does not function properly after the application of lubrication should contact Little Giant for evaluation. If a lock does not function properly after this evaluation, the company will offer the choice of a replacement ladder of the same or equivalent model or a refund ranging from a depreciated value determined by date of purchase up to full purchase price for ladders purchased within the past 12 months," said the USCPC on its page.Which ladder models are being recalledThe CPSC says the following models of Little Giant ladders are being recalled: Adjustable Fortress 2.0, Conquest 2.0, Dark Horse 2.0, Epic, King Kombo XT, Leveler, MegaLite, MegaLite+, Multi, Quantum and Vector.You use AI every day. articles.title: Ousted Videocon promoter Dhoot declared bankrupt over dues worth Rs 12,668cr
articles.summary: NEW DELHI: From a Bajaj Auto dealership in Maharashtra to one of the largest consumer durable companies in the country, life has come full circle for
articles.body: NEW DELHI: From a Bajaj Auto dealership in Maharashtra to one of the largest consumer durable companies in the country, life has come full circle for Videocon Industries' ousted promoter Venugopal Dhoot who was declared bankrupt by National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT) a day before Dhanteras, reports Amit Anand Choudhary.Dhoot is one of the most high-profile individuals to be declared bankrupt under the decade-old Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, with the Mumbai bench of NCLT directing him to file his statement of financial position within seven days with the bankruptcy trustee Asish Narayan, who will manage his estate.A bench of judicial member Vinay Goel and technical member Charanjeet Singh Gulati declared Dhoot bankrupt over dues of Rs 12,668 crore, including interest and penalty, as he had given a personal guarantee for credit facilities extended to Videocon Industries and borrowings connected with Videocon Telecommunications. articles.body: Karnataka minister Rizwan Arshad Friday alleged that tests at state-authorised labs found "excess" mixing of ethanol in E20 fuel, as high as 31.2% in some cases. Samples were collected from 63 petrol bunks across the state and 14 of them had ethanol above the prescribed limit, he said. PSUs denied the claim, saying it was not supported by tests conducted under statutory and technical procedures.
